topics.name: lesson design and content quality
topics.description: Lesson format, length, pacing, repetition, exercise variety, curriculum flow and spaced review.

topics.name: streaks gamification and motivation
topics.description: Streaks, badges, leagues, XP, gems, reminders and other game or motivation mechanics, whether they help or feel manipulative.

topics.name: speaking and pronunciation feedback
topics.description: Accuracy, usefulness and reliability of speech recognition, mic scoring and accent or pronunciation feedback in speaking exercises.

topics.name: conversation bot practice
topics.description: Experiences with the AI chat or roleplay partner, including naturalness, scenarios, error correction, repetitiveness and voice versus text.

topics.name: language and course coverage
topics.description: Availability, depth and level range of languages and courses, plus dialect options and course-direction limits.

topics.name: live tutor sessions
topics.description: Quality, availability, booking, cancellation and reliability of live human tutors and their sessions.

topics.name: grammar teaching and explanations
topics.description: How well grammar rules, reference material and explanations are provided, including missing grammar help and clarity of explanations.

topics.name: offline mode sync and bugs
topics.description: Offline downloads, device syncing, installation, login problems and other technical reliability issues.

topics.name: progress tracking and placement
topics.description: Placement tests, level estimates, skill charts, dashboards, reports and tracking of learning progress.

topics.name: pricing and account management
topics.description: Subscription costs, plans, billing and renewals, refunds, privacy, account deletion and support.

method.providerLabel: Two-phase topics (Anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5 (topic-discovery-v2) → consolidation (topic-consolidation-v4) + TypeSafe jev-latest (jev-topic-a1), batches of ≤ 25)
